items.title: 14.3.1 The Cross Product or Vector Product of Two Vectors and its Geometrical Interpretation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum vectors ko multiply karne ka naya tareeqa seekhenge: cross product. Dot product mein jawab sirf ek number tha. Yahan jawab ek poora vector hoga, jis ki lambai bhi hogi aur direction bhi. Physics mein yeh bohat kaam aata hai: magnetic field mein charge par force, ghoomti cheezon ka torque, sab cross product se likhe jate hain.

Kitab kehti hai: space ke vectors mein multiplication ka ek aham amal cross product hai. Dot product ka jawab scalar hota hai, lekin do vectors ka cross product ek vector quantity deta hai. Physics mein, khaas taur par fields, mechanics aur electricity mein, iska bohat istemal hai. Yeh sirf space (3D) ke vectors ke liye define hai.

Ab definition: maan lijiye \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) do non-zero vectors hain. In ka cross (ya vector) product, jise \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) likhte hain (parhte hain 'u cross v'), ek aisa vector hai jo \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) dono par perpendicular ho, aur yeh is tarah define hai:

blocks.text_alt: u cross v equals (modulus of u times modulus of v times sine theta) times n

blocks.text: Yahan \(\theta\) dono vectors ke darmiyan angle hai, jahan \(0 \le \theta \le \pi\) (yani 0 se 180 degree tak), aur \(\underline{n}\) ek unit vector (lambai 1) hai jo \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) wale plane par perpendicular hai, aur is ki direction right hand rule se tay hoti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is formula ko do hisson mein samajhiye, phir yeh mushkil nahin lagega:
1. Magnitude (size): \(|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}| = |\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta\). Kyun? Kyun ke \(\underline{n}\) unit vector hai, \(|\underline{n}| = 1\), to woh size par koi asar nahin dalta. Aur \(\theta\) 0 se 180 degree ke beech hai, is range mein \(\sin\theta\) kabhi negative nahin hota. Is liye cross product ki lambai kabhi negative nahin hoti.
2. Direction: unit vector \(\underline{n}\), jo \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ke plane par khara hai. Lekin ek plane par do perpendicular directions hoti hain: upar aur neeche (jaise mez par khari pencil upar bhi ho sakti hai, aur mez ke neeche ulti bhi). Konsi lein? Iska faisla right hand rule karta hai.
Sirf space mein kyun? Agar do vectors ek kaghaz par pare hon, to un dono par perpendicular direction kaghaz se bahar nikalti hai. Is ke liye teesri dimension chahiye; isi liye cross product 3D ki cheez hai.

blocks.alt: Two panels on grey-violet planes. Figure (a): vectors u and v from a point with theta between them; n and u cross v point straight up; beside them a right hand with the thumb up, labelled Right hand. Figure (b): vectors u and v from a point with a right-angle mark; n and v cross u point straight down below the plane; a right hand with the thumb down and an arrow along it, labelled Right hand.
blocks.caption: Figure (a): direction of u × v; Figure (b): direction of v × u, by the right hand rule (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Figure ko ghaur se dekhiye. Figure (a) mein \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ek plane (kaghaz jaisi sateh) mein pare hain, un ke beech angle \(\theta\) hai, aur \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) plane se seedha upar khara hai. Saath bana haath angootha upar kiye hue hai. Figure (b) mein wahi kaam ulti tarteeb se hua hai, yani \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\), aur ab angootha neeche hai, to vector bhi plane ke neeche ki taraf hai.

items: (i) Agar seedhe (right) haath ki ungliyan vector \(\underline{u}\) ki taraf hon aur phir vector \(\underline{v}\) ki taraf mudein (curl karein), to angootha \(\underline{n}\) ki direction dega, jo \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) ki direction hai. Yeh figure (a) mein dikhaya gaya hai.
(ii) Figure (b) mein right hand rule \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) ki direction dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Right hand rule ko qadam ba qadam lagaiye, abhi apna haath utha kar try kijiye:
1. \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ko ek hi nuqte se shuru kijiye (tail to tail, dono ki dum ek jagah).
2. SEEDHE haath ki ungliyan pehle vector \(\underline{u}\) ki taraf seedhi kijiye.
3. Ab ungliyon ko doosre vector \(\underline{v}\) ki taraf mod dijiye, chhote angle \(\theta\) ke raaste.
4. Ab angootha jidhar hai, \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) udhar hai.
Kyun: yeh sirf ek mutafiqa qaida (convention) hai, lekin poori duniya ki science isi par chalti hai, is liye hamesha right hand hi istemal karein.
\(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) ke liye \(\underline{v}\) se shuru kar ke \(\underline{u}\) ki taraf modiye: haath ulat jata hai aur angootha neeche aa jata hai. Size wahi, direction ulti. Isi liye cross product mein vectors ki tarteeb bohat ahem hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Size wali misaal (hamari taraf se, kitab ka sawal nahin): \(|\underline{u}| = 3\), \(|\underline{v}| = 4\) aur \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) hai.
\[|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}| = 3 \cdot 4 \cdot \sin 30^{\circ}\]
\[= 12 \cdot \tfrac{1}{2} = 6\]
Kyun: \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\). Yaani jawab ki lambai 6 hai, aur direction \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ke plane par perpendicular, us taraf jidhar right hand ka angootha bataye.
Ab sochiye: agar \(\theta = 90^{\circ}\) hota to \(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\) aur lambai poori \(12\) hoti. Yani vectors jitne zyada 'tirchhe' (perpendicular ke qareeb) hon, cross product utna bara.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\underline{i}\) ko \(x\)-axis aur \(\underline{j}\) ko \(y\)-axis ki taraf rakhiye. Ungliyan \(\underline{i}\) ki taraf, phir \(\underline{j}\) ki taraf modiye. Angootha kidhar gaya? (Jawab: \(z\)-axis ki positive taraf, yani \(\underline{k}\) ki taraf. Yeh nateeja hum 14.3.3 mein saabit karenge.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = (|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta)\,\underline{n}\), jahan \(0 \le \theta \le \pi\).
2. \(\underline{n}\) unit vector hai jo \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ke plane par perpendicular hai.
3. Direction: ungliyan \(\underline{u}\) ki taraf, \(\underline{v}\) ki taraf modein, angootha \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) deta hai.
4. \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) ki lambai wahi, direction ulti.
5. \(|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}| = |\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta\) kabhi negative nahin hota.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Ulta (left) haath istemal karna: qaida sirf seedhe haath se chalta hai. Ulte haath se direction bilkul ulti aayegi.
2. \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) poocha ho aur ungliyan \(\underline{v}\) se \(\underline{u}\) ki taraf modna: hamesha pehle vector se shuru kijiye.
3. Cross product mein \(\cos\theta\) likh dena: \(\cos\theta\) dot product ka hai, cross product mein \(\sin\theta\) aata hai. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: cross ka 's' aur sine ka 's'.
4. \(\underline{n}\) bhool jana: us ke baghair \(|\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta\) sirf lambai hai, poora vector nahin.
